meta.description: Generates 3D conformer ensembles using RDKit ETKDGv3 with knowledge-enhanced distance geometry, MMFF94/UFF force-field optimization, CREST + GFN2-xTB semi-empirical refinement, and macrocycle-aware torsion preferences. Provides explicit decision rules for single vs ensemble conformer use, RMSD pruning, energy windows, conformer count, and force-field choice. Use when preparing 3D ligands for docking, generating descriptor input for 3D QSAR, or sampling macrocycle/peptide conformational ensembles.

scientific_integrity.detail: All cited references remain real, verifiable, correctly attributed (unchanged from pre-fix audit). No fabricated data, statistics, or results in any of the 9 executed outputs, including the 2 new inputs.

practice_boundaries.detail: Pure computational-chemistry geometry tool; no diagnostic, prescriptive, or patient-facing content. No medical disclaimer applicable.

methodological_ground.detail: No methodological fallacy detected. The Skill's own caveats about Boltzmann populations being 'exploratory surrogates, not generally validated populations' still hold and are not contradicted by any executed output.

code_usability.detail: All 9 code paths executed to completion. The two P1 defects from the pre-fix audit (opaque ArgumentError on malformed SMILES; undocumented CREST Windows failure) are both resolved and verified fixed. Two new minor (P2) edge-case gaps were found (empty-string SMILES bypasses the new guard's message; filter_by_energy() crashes ungracefully on an empty conformer list) but both still raise real, traceable ValueErrors, not silent failures or crashes -- consistent with PASS.

functional_suitability.note: Windows/CREST caveat now present, accurate, and independently verified: crest_workflow() raises FileNotFoundError exactly as documented; the recommended fallback (RDKit macrocycle-aware embedding + standalone xtb --opt) was executed on a molecule the fixer did not test and produced a real GFN2-optimized geometry. recommendations.title: filter_by_energy() / filter_energy_window() crash ungracefully on an empty conformer list
recommendations.problem: Both the SKILL.md gen_conformers() pipeline's filter_by_energy() and examples/gen_conformers.py's filter_energy_window() call min(energies) unguarded. If RMSD pruning ever removes every conformer, the next pipeline step raises a raw 'ValueError: min() iterable argument is empty' with no context, unlike the clear guarded errors the rest of the Skill now uses consistently.
recommendations.root_cause: The energy-window filter was not included in the same guard-consistency pass that fixed gen_conformers()'s missing mol-is-None check.
recommendations.fix: Add an explicit check at the top of both functions: 'if not conf_ids: return []' (or raise a clear ValueError naming the empty-pruning cause), matching the empty-input handling already present in filter_energy_window()'s own conf_data check in examples/gen_conformers.py.

recommendations.title: gen_conformers()'s mol-is-None guard does not catch empty-string SMILES
recommendations.problem: Chem.MolFromSmiles('') returns a valid Mol object with 0 atoms (not None) in the installed RDKit build, so the new 'if mol is None' guard does not fire for this input; RDKit's own EmbedMultipleConfs eventually raises 'ValueError: molecule has no atoms' instead of the guard's intended 'Invalid SMILES' message.
recommendations.root_cause: The guard checks only for None; it does not also check GetNumAtoms() == 0, which is a second way RDKit signals an unusable SMILES.
recommendations.fix: Extend the guard to 'if mol is None or mol.GetNumAtoms() == 0: raise ValueError(...)' in gen_conformers(), macrocycle_conformers(), and crest_workflow() for consistency.

recommendations.title: Macrocycle-aware embedding's claimed benefit still has no worked before/after example
recommendations.problem: Unchanged from the pre-fix audit: a genuine >=12-atom carbocycle test still shows default ETKDGv3 settings succeeding equally (50/50) alongside useMacrocycleTorsions=True, so the documented under-sampling claim remains undemonstrated by any example in the Skill.
recommendations.root_cause: This P2 was explicitly scoped out of the current fix dispatch (fix log: 'not in this dispatch's scope... left for a future pass').
recommendations.fix: Add a concrete before/after example (e.g. cyclosporine A, already named in usage-guide.md but never coded) showing embedding failure or degraded diversity under default settings versus success under useMacrocycleTorsions=True.
